title: Remove 'Mandatory' from wizard heading: wizard is no longer a mandatory gate since backlog-58
goal: The wizard screen heading still reads 'Mandatory Assessment Wizard'. Since backlog-58 (free navigation foundation) was implemented, the wizard is the recommended start for new engagements — not a forced gate. Update the heading in ui/index.html from 'Mandatory Assessment Wizard' to 'Assessment Wizard' or 'Mission Intake'. Also check the sidebar nav label ('Mandatory Wizard' if present) and any other strings that include the word 'Mandatory' applied to the wizard flow specifically. The word 'mandatory' should only appear in ROE/authorization gate contexts.
